fields.title: Verify at Scale
fields.inputs/3/label: Full-text search across the entire catalog
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each solution, describe how costs behave with a 10x growth.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Recalculating recommendations on every screen open
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Full-text search querying the entire catalog
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/4: Persistent connection to the app for instant updates
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — linear by users, but expensive; fixed with background recalculation. 2 — superlinear due to accumulation. 3 — linear, does not drop, will start dominating as it grows. 4 — superlinear: gets more expensive from both the number of requests and catalog size. 5 — linear by concurrent users, but with a high coefficient. Rule of thumb: look for things that depend on both the number of operations and the total volume.
